interpretation: A manual-release grasp objective has no rotation requirement. Settling can rotate the pen substantially without earning rotation credit.
All seven predefined placement buckets include independent continuous uniform +/-0.25mm xyz and +/-0.5deg yaw jitter, with no state filtering or retry.
Zero-action development baseline: nominal Linux24/28, Mac27/28; randomization0.3 Linux15/28, Mac18/28. All initializations valid, no drops; failures at the final hold gate.
Nominal baseline already strong; first pilot uses frozen0.3 randomization to learn stabilization under actuator and physical variation.
Development2111000..2111027 used for baseline and subsequent checkpoint choice. Formal2211000..2211099 reserved for the selected policy only, then paired baseline evaluation.
Only the grasp job additionally requires formal policy success/drop counts at least as good as matched hold baseline, beyond original100-episode80%/10% thresholds.
No automatic rotation curriculum for this task. Legacy rotation policy and failed7/100 formal result remain unchanged.
